title: When libcurl uses libssh2 with a hashed known_hosts file, an unrelated initial entry can cause host key validation to report a key mismatch as a… (CVE-2026-87865)
description: A vulnerability in libcurl when used with libssh2 and a hashed known_hosts file causes host key validation to incorrectly report a key mismatch as a missing key in the SSH key callback.
aiSummary: When libcurl uses libssh2 with a hashed known_hosts file, an unrelated initial entry can cause the host key validation process to report a key mismatch as a missing key to the CURLOPT_SSH_KEYFUNCTION callback. This behavior may affect the accuracy of host key validation during SSH connections.
aiImpact: The vulnerability causes incorrect reporting of host key validation status, potentially misleading applications relying on the CURLOPT_SSH_KEYFUNCTION callback about the presence or mismatch of host keys. There is no indication of direct compromise or exploitation in the provided data.
